anatomy: Source stereo and both wrist views show the single long upper-edge incision enclosed by two elongated banks, matching public wound1. Nearby pad edge and the curved adjoining interior relief distinguish it from paired short or branched wounds2–6.
dataset_provenance: SutureBot paper Figure2 and hardware description state the collected training dataset uses wound1; tissue_3 is a recording session, not a wound class.
limitations: Human source-only visual confirmation plus dataset provenance; no claim of an automatic six-class recognizer.
